purchaseReady.branchBound: Draft branch: {{branch}}. Switching branch clears unsent forms. Saved requests stay with their original branch.
purchaseReady.switchTitle: Switch branch and clear unsent forms?
purchaseReady.pending: Outcome not confirmed. Retry this saved request; do not create another reference. The exact request is retained when you leave this screen.
purchaseReady.rejected: The server rejected this request. You can review the error and correct the form.
purchaseReady.partialHint: Enter only the quantities delivered now. Leave other quantities blank. A positive row must have all required batch details.
purchaseReady.rowInvalid: Correct: {{fields}}. No receipt lines have been submitted.

fields.quantity: quantity (positive, within remaining, up to 3 decimals)
fields.unitCost: purchase cost (0 or more, up to 2 decimals)

purchaseReady.nextReceive: Next: receive a partial or full delivery below.
purchaseReady.complete: Fully received. Review receipts and resulting batches below.
purchaseReady.cancelled: Cancelled. Receiving is unavailable; historical receipts remain visible.
purchaseReady.noAmend: Submitted orders cannot be amended or cancelled by the current service. Check lines before submitting. For a correction after submission, keep this order for history and contact your pharmacy manager before creating a replacement. Never receive an unwanted delivery to close an order.
purchaseReady.draft: Unsent draft · edit quantities or remove products before submitting
purchaseReady.batchRecorded: Batch created or matched by receiving
purchaseReady.priceHistoryNote: Receipt cost and quantity are historical. Selling price is the batch’s current price; this model does not store its price at receipt.
purchaseReady.detailFailed: Could not load detail. Retry to retrieve the saved record.
purchaseReady.historyOffline: Receipt details and full history require a connection. Recent synchronized references remain below.
purchaseReady.supplierSearch: Search suppliers by name, code, phone or email
purchaseReady.archiveConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? Existing orders and receipts stay linked. This supplier cannot be selected for a new order.
purchaseReady.inactive: Inactive supplier · existing orders can still be received.
purchaseReady.noProvenance: No purchase receipt is linked to this batch. It may originate from opening stock or another inventory movement.
purchaseReady.invalidOrder: Every order line needs a positive quantity (up to 3 decimals), a valid cost (up to 2 decimals), and a valid expected date when provided.
purchaseReady.identityMismatch: This lot conflicts with its existing batch identity or selling price. Check the product, lot, expiry and price before retrying.
purchaseReady.storageRequired: Durable storage is unavailable. This request has not been sent.
purchaseReady.noActiveSuppliers: Add or reactivate a supplier before creating an order.
purchaseReady.quantityHint: Blank = not delivered now. Zero and negative quantities are invalid.
purchaseReady.accessRefreshRequired: Purchasing needs current permissions. Refresh access to continue; your unsent forms are retained.
